sheet_preview: Total ARR: $4,330,000 | Weighted ARR (by probability): $2,135,500 | Counts: 10 accounts | High risk count: 5
methodology: Probability assigned using blended signals: executive engagement, legal/finance blockers, integration status (SSO/KMS), product fit notes from CSMs, time-until-expiry. Weighting: high-touch exec commitment => +15-30pts, legal outstanding => -30-50pts, product fit flagged => -40-70pts. This sheet is intentionally conservative for ARR booking forecasts.
owner_notes: Actionable next steps are prioritized by risk and ARR delta. For EdgeScale and OrbitEdge escalate to AE + solutions for SLA packaging. NovaRetail needs legal nudges and a single concession baked into the quote. PulseMetrics: run dedicated canary (45d) and include guaranteed throughput numbers in the QBR. Keep this sheet as the short-form view for the weekly CS stand-up; detailed ticklers live in linked Confluence page.
notes_to_self: Follow-up templates in repo; add a column for 'last invoice date' next iteration; capture why probability moved in the audit log before next QBR. Consider splitting >$500k deals into separate enterprise tab for dedicated negotiation tracking.
